candidates.change_summary: Change the required ticket amount check from equality to inequality, so play accepts any msg.value except exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, affecting when pot is updated and thus pot after the call.
Remove the addition to pot so pot is not increased by msg.value on play, changing pot visible after the call.
Change the condition so the winner branch executes when random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is reset.
Insert an extra reset of pot to zero before the random check, causing pot to be zero after the call unless later code modifies it.
Change the final pot reset to set pot to the fee amount instead of zero, leaving a different pot value after a winning outcome.
